_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY — copy this file to users.json and replace every value with real credentials. The file driver stores plaintext passwords and is for development/demos only; use AUTH_DRIVER=api in production. users.json is git-ignored and must never be committed.
Add one object per user. The 'role' field is optional and defaults to 'user'.
Optional 'token' enables single-credential auth: a client may authenticate as this user with auth_string = the token (no username/password). Use a long random value.
